from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """
    One paper in the collection with its reference relationships.
    References: papers this paper explicitly cites (extractable from this document).
    Citations: papers that cite this paper (requires cross-document aggregation).
    """
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references: list[str] = Field(
        description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography"
    )
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(
        description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper (populated by downstream aggregation)"
    )

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all papers with their reference/citation relationships."""
    papers: list[Paper]
